thread:
rachel_cs: Morning all  kicking off Sundial onboarding. Quick context: Sundial is replacing an older triage assistant; primary asks: fast integration, EU data residency, and strong guardrails for hallucination. Sprint-0 (10 days) goals: 1) Redwood Hosted wired into their ticket pipeline in staging, 2) run 10-sample latency+quality smoke, 3) Console walkthrough for their CSMs + feedback capture. Who owns which piece?

ben_pm: I'll be the Sundial PM contact. Weekly sync Fri 9am PT works. I'll introduce their infra lead (Sara) and provide the anonymized ticket export by Day 2.

sara_sre: Sara (Sundial infra) here. We require webhook signing, IP allowlist, and EU residency for PII. If Hosted can't meet residency, we need Dedicated or regional fallback. Will coordinate CIDRs today.

mohit_success: I'll own success criteria and acceptance tests. Draft: (a) staging E2E ticket flow validated, (b) 95th pct latency <350ms on the sample set, (c) CSMs complete Console checklist and pass a short runbook quiz. Flag renewal risk if go-live misses Day 28.

keira_se: I'll handle model selection and integration pairing. Need staging API key, sample webhook payloads, and 10 anonymized tickets. I'll share a tiny smoke-test curl and a Node example.

onboard-bot: Reminder: onboarding checklist at /docs/onboarding/sundial-template  includes Console runbook, API quickstart, security questionnaire, and prompt eval set.

rachel_cs: Action items: 1) ben to intro Sara + SRE by EOD; 2) Sundial to provide staging keys + payloads + 10 tickets by Day 2; 3) keira to provide model recs + smoke tests Day 1-3; 4) mohit to draft acceptance tests Day 2; 5) I'll create the sprint board and assign owners today. Note: capture legal/compliance gating now.

sara_sre: Opening infra ticket for allowlist/peering/signing. ETA 48-72h. If peering delayed, we'll accept a signed-webhook proxy.

keira_se: Quick curl sanity snippet for their engs:
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -d '{"input":"Summarize ticket: <body>"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

mohit_success: I'll confirm EU routing and fallback options by tomorrow and post any cost delta if Dedicated is required.

rachel_cs: First sync Fri 9am PT  invite incoming. Small ask: after 48h have CSMs try the Console runbook and drop feedback in the board so we can iterate quickly. :thumbsup:

ben_pm: Sounds great. Intro email going out now. Excited to get started.

(onboarding thread ended)
